g.text: The whole changed state placed in one token group at one layer, on each model
the input token, then the model's sampled layers, first to last
Outlined: the bridge word's last layer at ≥ 0.3; the first layer from which it switches ≤ 0.1. 9B, clean one-
pick scenes; 27B, clean one-pick scenes; Muse, clean one-pick scenes; Lightning, main test (two people swap
picks), hollow. Hollow: Lightning's gate chosen after the 60-scene pre-check was seen.
